description: Read one community reserve line by its id, which is keyless, list every line toward one goal (a packet on the board), which is keyless too and shows no wallet on any line, or list the lines one wallet holds, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make, oldest first. For each: covered, released, withdrawn or expired and why, the cap in NET units, when it lapses, and, in the holder's own signed list only, what the wallet's NET balance showed when it was signed (a read by id or by goal shows no balance). To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. It says plainly that the NET is not held and that no pot exists: a reserve line is a record, never custody, never a lock and never a pool. Free; a read by id or by goal is keyless, and a list by wallet is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

contributionId.description: The line's id (the contributionId it was committed under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a contributor, to list its lines. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

workId.description: Or the id of a goal packet on the board, to list every line toward it. A read by goal is keyless: nothing to sign.

name: net_contribution_status
title: Where a community reserve line stands, or every line toward a goal, or every line one wallet holds (a signed read)
